Definition: of uncertain derivation; motley, i.e. various in character:--divers, manifold.
BiblicalUsage: Poikilos means many-coloured, various, diverse. James says to count it joy when you fall into divers temptations in James 1:2, and Peter speaks of the manifold grace of God in 1 Peter 4:10. Jesus healed the sick with divers diseases in Matthew 4:24, and God bore witness with signs and wonders and divers miracles in Hebrews 2:4.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God's grace is manifold because my trials are — no two the same, and no trial without a grace to match it. That is why I hold that diversity is not confusion but the richness of His care.
